about: Land cessions by the Cherokee, Chickasaw, Choctaw, Muscogee (Creek) and Seminole nations, numbered as Charles C. Royce numbered them and dated by the treaty, statute or executive order that took the ground.
source: USDA Forest Service, Tribal Land Cessions in the United States (S_USA.TRIBALCEDEDLANDS), 2018-05-29, from Charles C. Royce, Indian Land Cessions in the United States, 18th Annual Report of the Bureau of American Ethnology, 1896-97.
licence: Public domain, 17 U.S.C. 105 (work of the US federal government). Access constraints: None. The 2018 revision was a collaboration of the USDA Forest Service Office of Tribal Relations, the NPS National NAGPRA Program, the EPA American Indian Environmental Office and Dr. Claudio Saunt of the University of Georgia; the Forest Service and Dr. Saunt digitised the Royce maps independently, and the polygons drawn here are the Forest Service ones.
simplified: Polygons simplified at 0.005 degrees. Measured maximum displacement 1.0 km, against a source georeferenced at 1:2,000,000 where a kilometre is the finest the georeference can carry.
